verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud's Basic/Serverless tier documents that Request Unit consumption scales to zero when a cluster has no activity, with RU usage visible and monthly cost estimates (docs-18, docs-22, docs-9, docs-17). Durability is backed by documented survival of disk, machine, rack and datacenter failures plus backup/restore. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that idle clusters cost literally nothing (storage billing while idle and any permanent free tier are undocumented; only $400 trial credits are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scale-to-zero behavior.
